description: This file contains the definition of configuration options and a validator class for Azure Table Storage within the Orleans framework. It includes a class specifying storage options such as table name, serialization preferences, and lifecycle stage, as well as a validator class for these options.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure Table Storage, allowing customization of table name, serialization, and storage lifecycle stage.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AzureTableStorageOptions, ensuring configuration validity.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the validator with specific options and name.
